body:
Root cause: in case of Consistency Level == 'One' (== YB_CONSISTENT_PREFIX) any tablet replica can be used to get READ (SELECT) request result. So, any FOLLOWER (non-leader replica) can be used to process the read request. 

When the read request is processed by Leader (in case of Consistency Level == QUORUM == YB_STRONG) the read time is correct. But if the request is processed by a Follower - the read time is invalid.
This happens due to invalid values returned by `yb::tablet::MvccManager::SafeTimeForFollower` method.

In case of 9 sec pause between write and read I see in the logs the following time values.
```
I0926 15:49:52.594996 112869376 tablet.cc:1993] HT SafeTime = { physical: 15695021 92 594 987 }
I0926 15:49:52.595088 112869376 tablet.cc:1994] HT SafeTimeForFollower = { physical: 15695021 83 590 826 }
```
 So MvccManager::SafeTimeForFollower provides invalid (9 sec in past) read time, while the MvccManager::SafeTime returns correct value.

issue.title: [YCQL] Unexpected results with TTL

repository.name: yugabyte-db
repository.description: YugabyteDB - the cloud native distributed SQL database for mission-critical applications.

issue.body:
# Description
I was playing around with TTL from the [docs](https://docs.yugabyte.com/latest/architecture/docdb/persistence/#update-row-with-ttl)
When you update a row with a greater time to live, the row doesn't have the expected data

## Steps to reproduce the issue:
Using `cqlsh -C`

```cql
CREATE KEYSPACE site;
CREATE TABLE site.page_views (page_id text, views int, category text, PRIMARY KEY ((page_id)));
INSERT INTO site.page_views (page_id, views) VALUES ('abc.com', 10)  USING TTL 5;
SELECT * FROM site.page_views;
UPDATE site.page_views USING TTL 10 SET category = 'news' WHERE page_id = 'abc.com';
SELECT * FROM site.page_views;
```

## Results Received:
- After Insert 
```
 page_id | views | category
---------+-------+----------
 abc.com |    10 |     null
```
- After Insert  +10s
```
 page_id | views | category
---------+-------+----------
 abc.com |    10 |     null
```
- After Update
```
 page_id | views | category
---------+-------+----------
 abc.com |  null |     news
```
- After Update + 10s
```
 page_id | views | category
---------+-------+----------
 abc.com |  null |     news
```

## Results Expected
- After Insert 
```
 page_id | views | category
---------+-------+----------
 abc.com |    10 |     null
```
- After Insert  +10s
```
 page_id | views | category
---------+-------+----------

```
- After Update
depending on the time after the initial command I would expect different results.
  - if update is within 5s I would expect:
```
 page_id | views | category
---------+-------+----------
 abc.com |    10 |     news
```
  - if update was greater than 5s I would expect an error since row does not exist with  `page_id = 'abc.com'`

## Versions used
yugabte: 1.3.1
cqlsh: 5.0.1
os: osx 10.14.6
